Marketing site only, no backend yet.", "targetKeyword": "ai saas landing page builder", "category": "Feature", "bodyHtml": "

What \"AI SaaS builder\" usually means, and what Kodely actually is

Search for \"AI SaaS builder\" and you'll find a lot of tools promising to generate a full working application — sign-up flow, database, billing, the works — from a single prompt. Most of the time that promise falls apart the moment you look under the hood. Kodely doesn't make that promise, so let's be upfront about what it does: Kodely is an AI tool that builds the marketing site for your SaaS. That's the page that actually explains what you built, shows pricing, and gets people to sign up. It does not generate your backend, your database, your auth system, or your payment processing. If you're looking for that, keep looking. If you're looking for a genuinely good, real, deployable landing page for your SaaS product built in minutes instead of a week, that's exactly what Kodely does today.

Why the marketing site is the part worth getting right first

Every SaaS founder eventually hits the same wall: the product is half-built, but there's no page to point people at. No way to validate demand, collect early sign-ups, or show a page to an investor or a Product Hunt audience. A polished, credible marketing site is often the highest-leverage thing you can ship before the app itself is done — and it's exactly the kind of scoped, well-defined interface that an AI tool can build well, because it's UI, copy, and layout, not business logic. Kodely is built for that job specifically, not as a lesser substitute for a full app builder.

How building a SaaS landing page in Kodely works

  1. Describe it in chat. Tell Kodely what your SaaS does, who it's for, and what you want on the page — a hero section, feature breakdown, pricing tiers, testimonials, an FAQ, a signup form, whatever your product needs.
  2. Watch it build for real. Kodely generates an actual Vite + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 application — real component files, not a filled-in template — starting from a hand-built set of UI primitives so the output looks considered from the first version, not generic.
  3. Preview the real thing. The live preview renders the actual compiled app as it's being built, so what you see is what will ship.
  4. Publish with one click. Your site goes live on a real public URL at <yourname>.kodely.site, free and included, with no separate hosting step.
  5. Keep refining in chat. Ask for a new pricing layout, a different hero, a testimonials section, or a copy rewrite, and Kodely edits the real components behind the page.

What you actually get

  • A real, working React codebase for your landing page, not a static mockup or a locked-down template.
  • Free checkpoints, so you can roll back to any prior version if a change doesn't land the way you wanted.
  • A code view inside the app to read and copy the generated source — useful if you want to hand a component to a developer or reuse a section elsewhere.
  • Credits that are metered from real AI cost, and a build that fails to compile is never charged.
  • A free tier of 750 credits on signup with no card required, so you can build and publish a first version before paying anything.

What Kodely doesn't do yet

To be direct about current scope: Kodely does not generate a backend, a database, authentication, or payment processing. The pricing page you build will look and read like a real pricing page, but it won't independently charge cards or manage subscriptions — that logic still lives in your actual product stack. A few other things worth knowing before you start:

  • No custom domains yet — published sites live on a kodely.site subdomain.
  • No project export or zip download. You can view and copy code from inside the app, but there's no one-click download of the full project.
  • No click-to-edit visual editing. Changes go through the chat interface, which edits the real components for you.

None of this is a hidden catch — it's the honest current shape of the product. If your SaaS needs a working backend today, Kodely isn't that tool yet. If you need a fast, real, good-looking way to get your product's story in front of people, it's a strong fit.

Pricing

You start with 750 free credits, no card required, which is generally enough to build and publish a first version of a SaaS landing page. Paid top-ups scale from there: $9 for 500 credits, $40 for 2,500 credits (the most popular option), and $90 for 6,000 credits. Credits never expire, and a failed build never costs you anything. Full details are on the pricing page.

Who this is for

This is built for SaaS founders, indie hackers, and small teams who need a real marketing site live now — before or alongside building the actual product — without waiting on a designer or a developer sprint. It's not for teams that need Kodely to generate their application logic; that's simply not what it does today. Try it against your own SaaS idea and judge the landing page it produces on its own merits — sign up free and see what it builds from a single description, or start from the Kodely homepage to see examples first.
